title: Extreme weather delays cargo ship
description: Severe weather has delayed the vessel carrying Microchip X by five days.

title: Port congestion delays shipment
description: Port congestion has delayed the Microchip X shipment by four days.

title: Geopolitical border closure
description: A border closure has delayed the overland route carrying Microchip X by six days.

title: Supplier factory shutdown
description: A factory incident stopped shipments from the primary Microchip X supplier.
